names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 13832, «Алексий (Никонов), иерей, сщмч.», with the two rank words left off; the day line gives «Алексия пресвитера» without the surname, and the surname is the index's.

death.note: The Russian day line, and the only thing printed about him besides his name and his rank: «Сщмч. Алексия пресвитера (1938)».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 16 октября ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Алексия пресвитера (1938).»
source.note: No rank is recorded: the line carries no service icon. The day has exactly one, standing before Longinus the Centurion at the head of the paragraph.

attestations.note: **The calendar prints a line and nothing else.** The day line gives the rank, the name and the year; his name page 13832 adds the surname, «Алексий (Никонов), иерей, сщмч.», and the second day he is kept on, «26 января (Новомуч.)» — and then stops. There is no life link on either page. His index number, 13832, stands immediately beside George (Troitsky)'s 13831, so the two were added to the calendar together; that is the calendar's own numbering and nothing is inferred from it. The January day was not read. azbyka.ru answered **403** to the corpus's own fetcher on 28 October 2026 and was not asked again.
